snippet.title: Fernwick  | Gameplay & Feature Update
snippet.description:
Fernwick has a new look! ♡

We've redesigned Junie's keepsake book, added a new opening animation, and updated the gameplay to bring even more of Fernwick's handmade world to life.

This update also showcases our hover-to-read feature, which lets players view handwritten notes in clearer text while preserving the original artwork.

Explore illustrated scenes, discover keepsakes, and uncover the memories Junie left behind in this cozy, narrative point-and-click adventure.

Wishlist Fernwick on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042300/Fernwick/

Developed and published by lostsave.exe
